key_insight: Simultaneous neural topology optimization jointly learns state, adjoint, and design fields to produce scalable, super-resolution stress-constrained designs.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets computationally demanding lightweight structural design while accounting for local stress constraints.
method: Jointly optimize custom neural networks using continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation.
Combine the design objective, aggregated local stress constraints, and potential energy functionals in one loss.
Distribute domain partitions across GPUs and accumulate gradients from sequential slices to limit peak memory while preserving field continuity.
evidence_signal: On 2D benchmarks, SNTO produced sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions than a conventional finite element-based approach; 3D demonstrations reached eight million collocation points on up to eight GPUs.
watch_item: Aggregated stress constraints warrant checking peak local stresses in an independent finite element validation, especially near sharp boundaries.
paper_title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
